eod.conclusion: Indian equities extended gains for a third straight session, with benchmarks climbing over 0.8% as reduced volatility supported the upward momentum. While markets surrendered some intraday advances, the sustained rally reflected growing confidence ahead of earnings season. Financial stocks led the charge, outperforming broader indices. Global developments including currency policy signals and overseas market movements created secondary influences, though domestic factors dominated trading psychology throughout the session.
